name: erpnext-playwright-ai-test-automation
description: AI-assisted Playwright test automation for ERPNext: scenarios written by a tester, tests generated by an AI agent, kept honest by rules, lints and CI.

scripts.erp:up: docker compose -p erpnext-qa -f docker/pwd.yml -f docker/apps.yml up -d && docker compose -p erpnext-qa -f docker/pwd.yml -f docker/apps.yml restart frontend
scripts.erp:down: docker compose -p erpnext-qa -f docker/pwd.yml -f docker/apps.yml down
scripts.erp:logs: docker compose -p erpnext-qa -f docker/pwd.yml -f docker/apps.yml logs -f create-site backend
